title: A Tale of Two Cities
summary: Set against the backdrop of the French Revolution, A Tale of Two Cities follows the intertwined lives of characters in London and Paris. Dr. Alexandre Manette is released from an eighteen-year imprisonment in the Bastille and reunited with his daughter Lucie, whose love brings him back to life. As political tensions escalate into revolution, Lucie's fiancé Charles Darnay, a French aristocrat hiding his identity, becomes entangled in the chaos. Sydney Carton, a dissolute English lawyer, finds redemption through self-sacrifice as he swaps places with Darnay on the guillotine. The novel explores themes of resurrection, sacrifice, and the destructive power of vengeance amidst societal upheaval.
